description: T1 item 9 (Testbenches shipped). cold_start is local_only: it needs the pinned combined IHP-Open-PDK checkout, ngspice >= 43 and a built psp103.osdi (sim/README.md), none of which a GitHub runner has. It runs sim/smoke/run_smoke.sh, which appends one sim/smoke/records/*.json per run. The 45-point closed-loop grid is inventoried but not cold-started here: it goes to the batch fleet through klt sim. See attest/README.md.
